name: arnega-monorepo
description: ArNega — local screen question-answering assistant for macOS. See it. Press Enter. Get the answer.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @arnega/shared && npm run typecheck -w @arnega/branding && npm run typecheck -w @arnega/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @arnega/website
scripts.test: npm run test -w @arnega/shared && npm run test -w @arnega/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:website && npm run build:desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
